declarations.name: AuiBusinessCalendar

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name; each grid is named "{label}, {month year}".

inputs.name: definition
inputs.description: Working days (default Monday to Friday), hours (default 09:00 to 17:00), weekday hours, holidays, and exceptions. Validated (BUSINESS_CALENDAR_DEFINITION).

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Enter, Space, or a click toggles a day between working and non-working (an exception).

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: First column (1 = Monday). Default: the locale's first day of week.

inputs.name: today
inputs.description: Advanced: fixed "today" for tests and demos.

inputs.name: months
inputs.description: Consecutive months shown, 1 to 12; the previous/next buttons page by this many.

inputs.name: showLegend
inputs.description: Show the legend of day kinds.

inputs.name: showHolidays
inputs.description: List the holidays of the visible months.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Month and weekday names, dates, numbers, the first day of the week, and messages.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA timezone of "today" (never the host machine zone, SPEC section 8.1).

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Reading direction; Left/Right arrow keys and chevrons follow it.

models.name: month
models.description: First visible month. Default: the month of the focused date.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: Edit mode: the user toggled a day; definition is the updated definition.

outputs.name: daySelected
outputs.description: The user activated a day (click, Enter, or Space), in both modes.

outputs.name: navigate
outputs.description: The visible months changed by user action.

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Show a date and make it the focused day (no events).

methods.name: setWorking
methods.description: Programmatic edit (no events): adds, or removes when redundant, an exception.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG grid (as Calendar): one table role=grid per month with a single roving tab stop across all months; every day cell names its date and kind.

limitations: One working-hours pattern per weekday (plus per-exception hours); no rotating shifts or per-week patterns.
Holidays are one-off dates or yearly on the same month and day; movable feasts (Easter) must be listed per year.
Editing toggles working/non-working only; holiday names and hours are edited in the definition.
Timezone rule accuracy for workingIntervals depends on the browser ICU data.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
